newsitem.title: USA: Republic says to buy Artz for $15.7 mln.
newsitem.headline: Republic says to buy Artz for $15.7 mln.

text.p: Republic Industries Inc said Friday it agreed to acquire Artz Automotive Group for $15.7 million, payable in Republic common stock.
The acquisition will be accounted for as a purchase transaction and is subject to the customary manufacturer and government approvals, Republic said.

The Artz Automotive Group includes Hal Artz Lincoln-Mercury, which operates two new car facilities selling Lincoln-Mercury, Jeep-Eagle, Hyundai and Isuzu automobiles, and four used car facilities located throughout the Cleveland area. The new and used car operations had combined 1996 revenue of approximately $50 million.
